evidence: synthetic software reproduction; not experimental validation
belowOnsetPolicy: Gaussian floor dispatch; above-onset point/line field has a residual discontinuity at P* despite continuous energy allocation
bandMethod: module-local one-at-a-time union; no interactions, confidence interval, error bar or bounds

labels.cavity: conditional scalar cavity hypothesis; numerical relaxation is not keyhole stability
labels.meltDepthLink: conditional thermal construction; Gaussian finite-source dispatch below onset
labels.marangoni: diagnostic scales from assumed deltaT and length; not a transport correction
labels.surfaceBalance: closure contradicted by IN625 mass-loss test; Ti/Al transfer; T, evaporation and recoil are closure artefacts
